monitor.notes: Shift tone reworked: now a smooth sustained tone (no more beeping) that sounds only while the revs are climbing — it cuts out the moment you lift or shift. The shift light itself is unchanged.

Shift light fixed & upgraded: it now blinks from your RPM warning up to the limiter, then holds a solid light + steady tone right near the limiter — before, it only fired at a single hidden 'shift RPM' that was easy to set above the revs you actually reach. Set your Redline (limiter) and RPM Warning and the light follows them. Works on any car.

G-meter upgrade for the upright dash mount: it now levels against gravity in 3 axes, so cornering and accel/braking read on the correct screen axes regardless of how far the gauge is tilted. Double-tap the G-meter to re-zero/align it to your car. If any direction reads mirrored, let us know and we'll flip it.

Steadier readouts: the Fuel % now holds a smooth average instead of swinging as fuel sloshes in corners, and the fuel-rail / oil pressure low-warning no longer flashes at start-up while the pressure is still building. A genuine low-pressure fault still alarms, and measurement accuracy is unchanged.

The Air/Fuel (AF ACT) readout now settles to a steady average instead of flickering with every closed-loop swing, so it's easy to read at a glance while still tracking a real change when you get on the throttle. Measurement accuracy and every other channel are unchanged.

New shift light: a steady flash with a matching beep that snaps on right at your shift RPM. The beep now uses the same clear tone as the warning alert and stays perfectly locked to the light — no fade-in and no drift, even when the screen is busy. Builds on the previous boost-response and smoothing fixes.

Boost responds faster: the gauge was adding noticeable lag to slow-updating readings (boost, pressures, mixture) by over-smoothing them — that's fixed, so boost tracks the throttle much more closely. Smooth channels stay smooth. Builds on the previous update (adaptive smoothing, boost arc centred with a -1 bar vacuum floor, on-screen update %, shift-light beep). Signed OTA.

Smoother gauges: every reading now glides instead of stepping. Before, only RPM looked smooth because the other values arrive from the car in bursts — the gauge now eases between them at each channel's own pace, so boost, temps, pressures and the rest move smoothly. Boost gauge: zero stays dead-center and the vacuum side is pinned to -1 bar — it won't read or sweep past full vacuum no matter how high your boost scale is set. And while the gauge is updating its firmware it now shows a live "UPDATING %" screen instead of sitting on the tap-to-allow card. (Also includes the shift-light beep that ticks in time with the light.) Signed OTA.

The shift-light beep is back — and now it ticks in time with the light. It starts beeping as the shift light comes on and speeds up to a rapid tick right at the limiter, so you can shift by ear without looking down. (Before, the tone was a single steady note at the shift point and didn't match the new fading/blinking light.) Signed OTA.

New shift light: a red ring around the screen fades in as you approach your shift point and pulses faster and faster into a rapid strobe right at the limiter — easy to catch at the edge of your vision. Smoother alarms: the warning screen no longer stutters the moment it pops up. Faster readings: boost, O2, oil/fuel pressures and the power/torque numbers now respond noticeably quicker while staying rock-steady — no more lag on the values (under 200 ms). Also rolls in everything since the last update. Signed OTA.

Fixes the new LANES live-graph page: the big value number was overlapping the channel name on each lane. The name now sits in a top band and the value in a bottom band with a clear gap between them. (If you don't have the LANES page yet, swipe to it or add it in the app.) Signed OTA.

node.notes: แบตมอเตอร์ (SOC) และน้ำมันไม่ค้างตอนขับ EV อีกต่อไป เมื่อก่อนพอรถวิ่งด้วยมอเตอร์ (เครื่องดับ) เซนเซอร์จะหยุดอ่าน OBD เพื่อกันชนเกตเวย์ ทำให้ % แบต/น้ำมันค้างค่าเดิม ตอนนี้จะแอบอ่าน SOC เบา ๆ ทุก ~10 วิระหว่างขับ EV และถ้ารถหยุดตอบจะขึ้น STALE แทนเลขค้างหลอก ๆ อ่านเฉพาะตอนรถพร้อมวิ่งเท่านั้น ไม่อ่านตอนจอดชาร์จ จึงไม่กินไฟแบตและไม่กวนเกตเวย์ ไม่เปลี่ยนโปรโตคอล ใช้ได้กับเกจทุกเวอร์ชัน (OTA-safe). ⚠ รุ่นทดสอบ: ช่วยสังเกตว่าค่ากลับมาหรือเกตเวย์ล็อกไหมระหว่างขับ EV

Boost responds much faster. The sensor was sharing its fast polling slots equally among every value on your gauge screen, so boost — the value you watch spool with the throttle — only refreshed a couple of times a second. It now gives the quick slots to the fast-moving values (boost, throttle, load) and polls the slow ones (temps, battery, voltage) in the background, so boost tracks the throttle 2-4x faster. No protocol change, works with any gauge version — OTA-safe.

Calculated gear is now far more accurate on cars without a direct gear signal: the sensor carries a built-in dictionary of 242 cars' gear ratios and, from your car's VIN, picks that model's actual ratio table (and self-selects the variant from how you drive) instead of two generic 8-speed tables. Also fixes two field bugs: (1) gatewayed cars that throttle the OBD port mid-drive (e.g. Civic FD, BMW F10) no longer 'false-sleep' and blank the gauge after 1-2 minutes — the sensor keeps re-probing while the engine is running and only sleeps once parked; (2) RPM no longer stair-steps / jumps in chunks under acceleration on cars with no passive RPM tap (e.g. Mazda2) — RPM gets priority polling slots again. No protocol change, fully backward compatible with any gauge version — OTA-safe.

The sensor now reports data-quality info alongside every reading: how fresh each value is (measured at the moment it's sent) plus link, timeout and bus-error counters. This lets the gauge know exactly how current each value is — used to keep the RPM needle smooth and honest. Fully backward compatible: nothing you see changes, and it works with any gauge version.

Fixes cars other than the Volvo showing no values. A change made for battery-saving on the Volvo accidentally treated any car without Volvo's specific data broadcast as 'off', so the sensor slept instead of reading it. It now recognises any running car by its live bus activity, so other makes read their engine data again — while the Volvo's parked battery-saving is kept.

Every value on a page now updates live. Before, only the first two values on a page refreshed quickly and the third and fourth lagged; now the sensor fast-polls all of the values you have on screen, so a hero page (big value plus its supporting figures) or a five-arc page updates smoothly across the board.
The smaller (2nd) value on a gauge page now refreshes as fast as the main value — the two stay in sync with no lag between them.
VIN auto-ID now recognizes Porsche + Mini/Land Rover/Jaguar/Tesla/Mitsubishi/Suzuki/Peugeot/Citroen/Renault/Fiat/Alfa/Jeep/Ram (were Unknown).
